name: Precise Connections, Inc.
old_description: with the highest degree of excellence. Whether we are helping you perfect a new design, or running production quantities of a time-tested PCA (Printed Circuit Assembly), our chief goal is to serve you.
about:
Precise Connections, Inc. has operated from Duncanville, Texas, since 1985. The privately held electronics contract manufacturer began in a small local building and has grown into a full turnkey operation spanning 39,000 square feet across two adjacent facilities. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing services, including PCB assembly (through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed-technology), custom box builds, cable and wire harness assembly, design-for-manufacturing consultation, functional testing, and supply-chain management. Prototypes and full production runs share the same floor, supported by an Aptean Made2Manage ERP system with Panasonic PanaCIM lot traceability and RFID-tracked inventory. The facility maintains a fully ESD-controlled environment with calibrated test equipment and a formal corrective-action process.

Precise serves OEMs across regulated and performance-critical markets such as energy storage, medical devices, industrial equipment, printing, audio, marine and marine audio, safety devices, railway, control systems, motion detection, IT and networking, and consumer products. The company also supports OEM programs and aftermarket service. Components are sourced globally through authorized distributors and factory-direct channels, with broker assistance for hard-to-find parts.

The firm emphasizes a single-point-of-contact model from design handoff through fulfillment, describing itself as "big enough to deliver, small enough to be agile." Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and compliant with IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620 up to Class III, with RoHS 2 adherence across all processes. In 2025, customer ratings earned Precise the Circuits Assembly Service Excellence Award for Responsiveness among EMS providers under $20 million in sales. The company cites 30 consecutive profitable quarters and a staff averaging more than ten years of industry experience as indicators of stability.

name: Precision Inc., a TT Electronics Company
old_description: At TT Electronics, we engineer and manufacture solutions that enable a safer, healthier and more sustainable world. From precision sensors and passive components to rugged power conversion and complex electronics assemblies, we are a trusted partner to OEMs in regulated markets worldwide.
about:
Precision Inc., a TT Electronics Company, is headquartered in Brooklyn Center, Minnesota. It operates as part of TT Electronics PLC, a UK-based global provider of advanced electronics technologies that has evolved over the last 100 years through brands such as AB Connectors, Aero Stanrew, BI Technologies, IRC, and Optek Technologies. The company is a subsidiary of a publicly listed group with 3,500-plus employees across 20 design and manufacturing facilities in the UK, North America, and Asia.

Precision Inc. designs and manufactures electronic solutions for performance-critical applications. Its capabilities span precision sensors, passive components, rugged power conversion, complex electronics assemblies, custom cable harness assemblies, optoelectronics components, and transformers. The vertically integrated model covers design through manufacturing, serving regulated markets with high-reliability electronics.

The company serves OEMs in aerospace and defence, healthcare, and automation and electrification. Concrete customer engagements include a Global Supplier Framework Agreement with Wabtec Corporation for transit, freight, and signalling; an extended partnership with Rolls-Royce for future aircraft power; work with MBDA Italia; and Optek Hall-effect sensors selected for NASA's Dragonfly mission fan assemblies.

TT Electronics states its purpose is to engineer and manufacture electronic solutions enabling a safer, healthier, and more sustainable world. The focus on regulated, high-reliability markets drives investment in vertical integration and design-led manufacturing to reduce programme risk before qualification begins.

name: Precision Medical Technologies
old_description: Precision Medical Technologies invests in our manufacturing process to deliver high-quality knee components and instruments for our customers. We have access to the latest innovative precision machining equipment to ensure every component is manufactured specifically for your surgeons.
about:
Precision Medical Technologies operates three facilities in northern Indiana, headquartered in Warsaw. The company has held ISO 13485:2016 certification since 2003 through SGS United Kingdom Limited, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides end-to-end contract manufacturing for orthopedic implants, components, and instrumentation. Its capabilities span design for manufacturability, prototyping, and high-volume production using precision CNC machining, Swiss turning, casting, turning, and finishing. All production is documented through device history records, with in-process inspections, final inspection, and product release audits. Sterile packaging and supply chain management complete the in-house offering.

Precision Medical Technologies serves original equipment manufacturers in orthopedics, including knee, hip, spine, shoulder, trauma and extremities, and minimally invasive surgery markets. Customers rely on the firm for tibial trays, femoral components, patellar components, and partial or total knee implants and instrumentation.

The company emphasizes a 24-hour quote response, vertical integration across its three Indiana sites, and the ability to complete production in a single operation. Its quality system maintains IQ, OQ, and PQ validation, with dimensional accuracy monitored via CMMs, optical comparators, and Keyence measuring systems.

name: Precision Molded Plastics
old_description: Precision is a vertically integrated, plastic injection molding company that builds custom molds and tooling, manufactures parts and products, and performs a variety of value-added services all under one roof. As such, we have been a trusted supplier of Fortune 500 companies in the medical, aerospace, food and beverage, construction, agriculture and other industries for over forty-five years.
about:
Precision Molded Plastics operates from Upland, California, where Ted F. VanVoorhis founded the company in 1979 as an ultra‑small‑parts specialty molder serving the electronics and early computer industries. VanVoorhis, a charter member of the Southern California chapter of the Society of Plastics Engineers, quickly established the firm as a leader in what is now known as micromolding. In 2004 his son David assumed leadership and became president and CEO in 2009, continuing the family‑owned operation.

The company specializes in high‑volume runs with a minimum annual program demand of 10,000 units, and supports programs with in‑house 3D printing for rapid prototypes, custom mold design and construction, and a full suite of secondary operations including machining, insert and overmolding, pad printing, hot stamping, thermal transfer decorating, assembly, packaging, and distribution.

Precision serves OEMs and Fortune 500 customers in medical, aerospace, food and beverage, construction, agriculture, irrigation, and electronics sectors. Its quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

The company emphasizes a one‑roof model that combines tooling, molding, finishing, and logistics, offers reshoring assistance and mold‑transfer services, and maintains an environmental focus that recycles materials and generates less non‑recyclable waste per week than the average household.

about:
Precision Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1976 in Beltsville, Maryland, by its current owner with the goal of providing custom plastic fabrication services to a broad range of industries. The company began by supplying merchandise displays and custom store fixtures to large retailers before expanding into more specialized work.

Today the firm operates as a full-service plastics manufacturer offering design, engineering, and manufacturing under one roof. Its capabilities span concept development, industrial design, 3D modeling, prototyping, testing, production planning, material sourcing, and finishing services such as engraving, polishing, and assembly. Fabrications range from one-of-a-kind prototypes to short-run production in plastics, wood, laminate, and metals.

The customer base includes retail chains, the U.S. Navy (for quarter-scale rocket models), national museums requiring complex display cases and archival enclosures, scientific and microscopy facilities needing precision instrument housings, trade-show exhibitors, signage and wayfinding programs, and makers of acrylic furniture and podiums. Projects have included museum-quality cases, laboratory equipment enclosures, trade-show displays, custom podiums, and interior signage systems.

Precision Plastics attributes its differentiation to nearly 50 years of industry experience, deep material expertise, innovative technology such as 3D design and digital fabrication integration, highly skilled craftspeople, rigorous quality control, and project management that keeps jobs on time and on budget.

old_description: Precision Plastics Packaging Co. (PPPC) is a leading full-service manufacturer of premium, private label products. It all started in 1963 with a simple printing unit. Our company’s location is a 120,000 square feet facility in Anaheim, California.  We employ about 150 people – many who have been with Precision Plastics Packaging Co. for more than two decades. Our technologies are intricate, but our approach to serving you is simple. We manufacture and decorate more than a million superior quality plastic containers per day. about:
Precision Plastics Packaging Co. (PPPC) was founded in 1963 in Anaheim, California, starting with a simple printing unit. The privately held company operates a 120,000-square-foot facility in Anaheim and employs approximately 150 people, many of whom have been with the company for over two decades.

PPPC manufactures and decorates plastic bottles using injection stretch blow molding, extrusion stretch blow molding, and silk screen printing with multi-head machines. The facility also runs hot-stamping operations. The company produces more than one million containers per day and employs both make-to-order and make-to-stock strategies to align production with demand forecasts.

The company serves cosmeceutical markets with FDA-approved bottles and acts as a certified vendor for that sector. Its customer base ranges from Fortune 500 corporations to small independent businesses, though specific client names are not disclosed.

PPPC attributes its growth to guiding principles of craftsmanship, commitment, quality, technological innovation, and inventiveness maintained over five decades. The firm emphasizes stability, innovation, and customization services as key differentiators that attract and retain customers.

old_description: When you find yourself in need of an expert to work with for your interior staining, you want to feel confident that you are getting the best there is. This is why so many residential and commercial clients rely on the team here at Precision Wood Finish to get the job done. Since 1994, we have been the local leading service provider for wood staining in the Bismark area, as well as a variety of other tasks. […]
about:
Precision Wood Finish has operated in Bismarck, North Dakota since 1994. The family-owned business was started by Don and Cindy and grew from a 2,700-square-foot shop serving Bismarck-Mandan into a 7,600-square-foot facility.

The company provides interior and exterior wood staining and finishing services for residential and commercial clients. Its shop-based process uses spray-applied stains, chemical coatings, glazes, and gel stains, with capabilities including custom color matching across wood species, horizontal spraying of doors, and a three-coat topcoat system. The controlled environment limits VOC exposure and ensures consistent results on items such as cabinetry, millwork, stair systems, entry doors, windows, barn doors, and cedar siding.

Customers range from homeowners refinishing kitchen cabinets and fireplace mantels to commercial projects like the NDSU wall art installation and trim packages for local builders. The company also finishes fiberglass and metal entry systems, patio doors, and specialty items such as bar tops.

Precision Wood Finish differentiates itself by keeping work in-house to control environmental conditions, using wax paper between doors during shipping, and offering custom stain matching that the owners say sets them apart from competitors who only claim expertise.

name: Premier Manufacturing
old_description: Our business has achieved this organic growth primarily through word of mouth and referrals. Our goal is to provide our customer partners with a quality, on-time product at a competitive cost while maintaining a work environment that is safe and rewarding for our employees.
about:
Manufacturing was established in 1999 in Mead, Colorado, by Edmond Johnson, who remains president and owner. The company began as a printed circuit board assembly operation and grew organically through word-of-mouth referrals to become one of Colorado's largest electronics manufacturing service providers, now operating a 45,000-square-foot facility along the Front Range.

The shop runs five manufacturing lines with 125 employees, offering full-service PCB contract manufacturing that spans new product introduction, prototype assembly, surface-mount and through-hole production, box-build integration, and test development. Processes include DEK, Samsung, and Mycronic pick-and-place equipment capable of 01005, BGA, micro-BGA, CGA, and LGA packages; 2D and 3D X-ray inspection; automated optical inspection on every line; selective and dual-wave soldering (RoHS and leaded); automated radial, axial, and DIP insertion; and in-line aqueous cleaning. Engineering partners with over 30 years of PCB experience provide DFM/DFT review, design services, and functional/in-circuit test solutions, while supply-chain management leverages Global Shop Solutions ERP and SiliconExpert's 250-million-part database for Kanban stocking and obsolescence forecasting.

Customers serve aerospace, medical, and broader electronics OEMs, with the quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D:2016. The program-management approach assigns a technical program manager to each account, and the company emphasizes copy-exact transitions from prototype to volume, dock-to-stock box-build delivery, and turnkey or consigned material models.

Johnson founded the business to deliver quality, on-time products at competitive cost while maintaining a safe, rewarding workplace—a philosophy the company calls its Advantage.

name: Premier Medical
old_description: As an FDA-compliant manufacturer of Class I and Class II dental/medical devices, we provide support services, including finishing operations and packaging. We maintain complete traceability and device-history records for every lot we process.
about:
Medical operates a 35,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Northeast Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company is an FDA-compliant manufacturer of Class I and Class II dental and medical devices, offering contract manufacturing services including finishing, packaging, and full traceability with device-history records for every lot.

The facility combines high-tolerance machining and injection molding with metal processing capabilities such as machining, forging, sharpening, brazing, and polishing of surgical-grade stainless steels (303, 304, 316, 440A), titanium, nitinol, copper, and brass. Plastic processing covers polyethylene, polypropylene, nylon, ABS, and Radel using molding units and cleaning procedures. Automated assembly and packaging are available for selected items, and in-house new product development teams support projects from concept to market-ready packages.

serves the dental and medical device industries, producing items such as impression trays, periodontal probes, composite polishing systems, ultrasonic inserts, reusable loop electrodes, gynecologic sampling instruments, cervical and uterine dilators, cannula instruments, molded products, and tracheostomy tubes. Customers include companies requiring precision metal and plastic components for surgical and diagnostic applications.

The company emphasizes complete lot traceability, decades of experience with specialized metals, and ISO 13485:2016 certification as differentiators. Automated packaging and in-house tooling design aim to ensure process repeatability for custom orders.

name: Premier Technical Plastics
old_description: Performance is what sets Premier Technical Plastics apart from other custom plastics injection molders. By combining the expertise of our technical services group with state-of-the-art equipment and professional project management, we ensure that the expectations and requirements of our customers are met on time, every time.
about:
Technical Plastics was founded in 1981 in Searcy, Arkansas. The company has operated as a custom plastics injection molder for over four decades, building a reputation for performance and quality in the plastics manufacturing industry.

The company specializes in custom injection molding of plastics components and assemblies, with a core capability in two-shot injection molding—a process that injects two different materials sequentially in a single mold cycle. Technical Plastics also operates a technical services group and uses state-of-the-art equipment with professional project management. In 2026, the company plans to expand its facility infrastructure, add two-shot molding capacity, and install two pad printing lines and corona surface treatment equipment for specialized decorative processes.

Technical Plastics serves customers requiring custom injection-molded plastics components and assemblies, though specific industries are not detailed in available materials.

The company emphasizes performance, combining technical expertise, advanced equipment, and project management to meet customer expectations on time. Its quality policy stresses continuous improvement, competitive pricing, and prompt service, backed by ISO 9001:2015 registration and UL certification for fabricated parts.
